question: Which of the two open debug-proxy CA recovery implementations should become the single canonical path before either PR is merged?
rationale: The branches address the same user-visible failure but use different publication designs; choosing the permanent concurrency and publication contract is a maintainer ownership decision, not a mechanical contributor follow-up.

options.title: Sponsor this PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this staged same-directory-rename implementation and request redacted runtime proof for `12b48ec5d6e328e3c31e4bcd78a87edb8d8155c0` before merge.

options.title: Adopt the alternate implementation
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109946 instead, then close or rework this PR so OpenClaw has one CA-generation owner.

options.title: Converge the approaches first
options.body: Ask the contributors to agree on one narrowly scoped implementation and submit only that final design for review.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this staged same-directory-rename implementation and request redacted runtime proof for `12b48ec5d6e328e3c31e4bcd78a87edb8d8155c0` before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current proposed implementation and is the available routing contact for supplying exact-head evidence or adapting the branch after the maintainer choice.
